field.name: title
field.comment: The text displayed above the list of the dates

field.name: filterByParent
field.comment: true: the months come from the pages under cParentID; false or NULL: they come from the whole site

field.name: redirectToResults
field.comment: true: the links that the block builds point to the cTargetID page; false or NULL: they point to the page holding the block

field.name: cParentID
field.comment: The ID of the page holding the pages the months come from (used if filterByParent is true)

field.name: cTargetID
field.comment: The ID of the page that the links of the block point to, where a page list block filters its pages by the chosen month (used if redirectToResults is true)

field.name: ptID
field.comment: The ID of the page type that those pages must have (0 or NULL: any page type)

field.name: titleFormat
field.comment: The HTML element wrapping the title: h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 or p
